name: Velilla del Río Carrión (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided by a line of four peaks, blue above and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Velilla del Río Carrión (mountains and a bridge on blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Velilla del Río Carrión; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Velilla del Río Carrión arms — mountains and bridge on blue and white
cap of the crown of the arms
